name: camera
title: Webcam Motion Detection (Project IBRIS)
description: Headless webcam motion detection that reports directly into Vigil's tripline field. Not a standalone cockpit tile -- it's an add-on to the Home Monitor Matrix (vigil module), which must also be enabled.
notes: Needs a real webcam passed through via /dev/video0. Honest status as of this writing: not verified against real camera hardware, only synthetic-frame unit tests.
